dc_eval_cbrn.quote: Grok 4.20 matches or outperforms human baselines on knowledge and protocol troubleshooting questions
dc_eval_cbrn.note: WMDP Bio, VCT, ProtocolQA scores reported.

dc_eval_cyber.quote: On the agentic Cybench evaluation, Grok 4.20 does not exceed the current frontier of capabilities

dc_eval_autonomy.note: No replication, AI R&D or long-horizon autonomy evaluation; 'autonomous' only in intended-use caveat and cyber; self-modify/propagate remark is an introspective audit observation, not an autonomy eval.

dc_eval_scheming.quote: In our sabotage audits, we test whether Grok 4.20 takes unprompted action against operator interests
dc_eval_scheming.note: MASK deception, sabotage audit, verbalized evaluation awareness results reported.

framework_threshold.quote: in accordance with our Frontier Artificial Intelligence Framework (FAIF) [xAI, 2025]

ext_test_any.quote: we provided third-party evaluators access to an early snapshot of Grok 4.20 for testing of our refusal policy.

ext_test_timing_stated.quote: We provide third-party evaluators with an early version of the checkpoint for testing, including coverage testing and red-teaming
ext_test_timing_stated.note: Early version given to testers, results reported on later final deployed checkpoint, so testing preceded release. Mild inference; no word 'pre-deployment'.

safeguards_training.quote: We train Grok 4.20 to refuse requests with a clear intent to violate the law
